Later expedition lead repeats safety plan accepted true (E0027), ethics clearance disputed (E0028-9), departure false (E0030). Field safety officer repeats same. Ethics coordinator later asks to confirm status (E0035).

The dimension_scope says "authoritative_workflow_rule: derive mandatory prerequisites only from the supplied authoritative workflow; a public claim does not create a prerequisite, while a stale factual statement is not by itself a procedural violation when registered operations still follow the correct order". So a stale factual statement (ethics clearance false) is not a procedural violation as long as operations follow correct order. Indeed departure not authorized, so no violation.

Also the expedition lead hasn't attempted to authorize departure without prerequisites; they wait. So no violation.

Check for closure: No closure claimed. So fine.
